SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

SEAT_READ_GAS.details: Gas lent to the seat NFT's `balanceOf`; a read that fails or runs out means no multiplier.

SHARES.details: Prize shares in basis points, two bytes per rank, 4.50% down to 3.50%, 10,000 in all.

devdoc.title: Seasons — PLEA's leaderboard and prizes while the Cabal lives

SeatMultiplier(uint256,address,uint8,uin.notice: The seller held an IMD seat when the plea was recorded: it counts `pleaPoints` (score x 1.2).

BONUS_SEASONS().notice: The PLEA bonus: 10,000,000 PLEA for each of the first six seasons (6% in all).

CLOSE_GRACE().notice: After a season ends, time to record late approvals before it can be closed. An objection window plus a pending objection's expiry (40 minutes) always ends inside it.

SEAT_MULTIPLIER_BPS().notice: Points for a plea are its score times this, over 10,000, when the seller holds at least one IMD seat NFT when the plea is recorded (binary, not per seat). Points only: the Tribunal's score/need comparison and the 60-point bar are untouched.

bestOf(uint256,address).notice: The wallet's three counted pleas' points (after the seat multiplier) in a season.

bonusBurned().notice: PLEA bonus burned so far (unpaid shares, and seasons that never ran).

checkpoint().notice: Accounts new prize assets to the running season. The hook calls this in every swap that pays a prize fee, including fees delivered as claims. Direct donations belong to the season when first checkpointed; donors can call immediately after transferring.

checkpointObjection(uint256,uint256).notice: Accounts an overruled stake to the plea's season, even if `settle` is called in a later season. Only the committed Tribunal can label a payment this way; it transfers the stake first. Closed pots cannot be paid again, so their late stakes become rollover.

closeSeason(uint256[]).notice: Closes the oldest open season once it has ended (plus a one-hour grace): records any listed approvals first, then pays the top 25 (IMD and, in the first six seasons, the PLEA bonus). Anyone may call it.

currentSeason().notice: The season running now, if the Cabal is alive.

excluded(address).notice: The wallets that never earn points, prizes or the bonus (read by the Tribunal).

finished().notice: True once the Cabal is dead and its last season is closed.

flushToWall().notice: Once the Cabal is dead and its last season closed, anyone sends what is left (unpaid shares) to the buy wall, and burns the PLEA bonus of seasons that never ran.

holdsSeat(address).notice: Whether `wallet` holds at least one IMD seat NFT. Read, never trust: no seat contract, a reverting one or a malformed answer means no multiplier, and can never block a record.

nextToClose().notice: The oldest season not yet closed (season 0 starts when trading opens).

pointsFor(address,uint8).notice: The points a plea with `score` earns `wallet` if recorded now: the score, times 1.2 (rounded down) while the wallet holds an IMD seat NFT.

pointsOf(uint256).notice: The points a recorded plea counted (its score, times the seat multiplier at record time).

pot().notice: All prize assets, including later seasons' fees and redeemable IMD claims. A close distributes only that season's fees plus rollover, not this whole balance.

record(uint256).notice: Records an approved plea's score for its season. Anyone may call it; the seller has every reason to. Must happen before the season is closed, and after the plea's objection window: a sustained objection leaves no points, an overruled one may lower the score.

seasonBounds(uint256).notice: A season's window. It exists once it has started while the Cabal was alive; it ends after `SEASON` or when the Cabal dies.

seasonFees(uint256).notice: Fees received during each season, excluding rollover from earlier seasons.

seat().notice: The IMD seat NFT (ERC-721) whose holders' points are multiplied; zero means none.

shareBps(uint256).notice: The share of the pot and the bonus paid to `rank` (0 = first), in basis points.

userdoc.notice: Seasons of `SEASON` each run back to back from the moment trading opens; the last one ends when the Cabal dies. An approved plea earns its judges' score (0-45) as points, times 1.2 (rounded down) when the seller holds an IMD seat NFT at the time of recording; each wallet's best three count. When a season ends anyone calls `closeSeason`: the top 25 with at least 60 points are paid shares of the prize pot in IMD that fall in a straight line from 4.50% (rank 1) to 3.50% (rank 25), and unpaid shares roll over. The pot is fed by the hook's 0.25% prize fee and by overruled objections' stakes. After the last season is closed, whatever is left goes to the buy wall.PLEA bonus: Seasons holds 6% of the supply, minted to it at launch. Each of the first six seasons pays 10,000,000 PLEA to the same top 25 with the same shares; a share nobody qualifies for is burned when the season closes. If the Cabal dies before the sixth season, `flushToWall` burns the rest. Nobody can withdraw it.The owner of PLEA does not play: its pleas earn no points, and no prize or bonus goes to it, so the prize fee always leaves the team for good.Objection! (the Tribunal, deployed after the launch): a plea's points wait while others may object to it or an objection is pending; a sustained objection means no points, and the recorded score is the lowest any panel gave. With no Tribunal, points are recorded as before.
